critique: The piece brilliantly juxtaposes the bold, primary-colored geometric overlays of De Stijl with the organic, pulsing diamond cells of a Game of Life simulation, achieving a striking architectural cyber-nature fusion. However, the drifting raster images and drop-shadowed placeholders feel too disconnected from the underlying generative systems; processing these photographic elements through a WebGL shader or halftone filter would better integrate them into the living, textured canvas.
